entities.summary: Johann Jakob von Pistor, also known as Yakov Matveyevich Pistor, was an 18th-century German general who served in the Imperial Russian Army. One of the most notable commanders of Russian forces in the Warsaw Uprising (1794), he authored a memoir on both the fights in Warsaw and the entire Kościuszko's Uprising.
